meta.direction: Pulse (2026-11-04): dark-first, glow instead of heavy borders, Geist + DM Mono. Mirrors the Subframe project Upstra (2957eba6f47b).

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: App background behind every surface. Near-black, never grey: it is what makes the glows read.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, toasts, table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Active nav item, selected segment, hover fill of rows and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: surface-modal
tokens.usage: Modal and drawer body.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, modal footer strip, input fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline on every card, panel and table row.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Card border on hover, control outlines, avatar ring.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of secondary buttons and inputs (kept for existing components).

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Titles, metric values, VM and host names on surface and page.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy, secondary values, button labels on surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Overlines, labels, timestamps, descriptions. 4.9:1 on surface in dark, 6:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Empty values (—) and disabled text only. Not for anything that must be read.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, active toggle, logo tile. White on it is 5.2:1.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill on hover; core of the brand glow.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Links, section icons and selected text on surface.

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Pressed primary fill, environment chip background.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and danger-solid fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: UP state: rings, dots, bars. Always beside a word or the filled-circle glyph.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Text for UP and nominal states on surface.

tokens.name: success-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of success pills and healthy host tiles.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Outline of healthy host tiles and the LIVE chip.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: DEGRADED state: triangle glyph, bars over threshold, warning card outline.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Text for degraded values and threshold breaches on surface.

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of warning pills, degraded host tiles and the warning KPI.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: DOWN / CRITICAL state: square glyph, battery ring under 40 %, event dots.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill and the CRITIQUE chip. White on it is 4.8:1.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Text for critical values and down states on surface.

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Large critical metrics (autonomy, 0 V input) at 22px and above.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of critical pills and down table rows.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Outline of the incident banner and critical cards.

tokens.name: neutral-light
tokens.usage: Legacy tailwind neutral.light; kept so existing classes resolve.

tokens.name: neutral-dark
tokens.usage: Legacy tailwind neutral.dark; kept so existing classes resolve.

tokens.name: neutral-darker
tokens.usage: Legacy tailwind neutral.darker; kept so existing classes resolve.

tokens.name: toggle-off
tokens.usage: ToggleSwitch track when off.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: BaseToast dot for success.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: BaseToast dot for error.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: BaseToast dot for info.

tokens.name: status-unknown
tokens.usage: UNKNOWN state: dashed-circle glyph. Neither green nor red: no data is not good news.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title and the incident headline.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, modal titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, sub-lines under names, status words.

styles.name: metric-lg
styles.usage: One hero number per screen at most.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: KPI values, autonomy in the incident banner.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Hostnames, IPs, W / V / °C values, table cells, the xterm console.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above values (CHARGE, AUTONOMIE), column heads, timestamps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to tight label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Glyph to status word, host tile gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon to text in headers, button gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, alert padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutter and incident banner padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Kbd hints, small chips inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, host tiles, rail items, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The incident banner only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, search field, segmented controls, dots, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Every card: a one-pixel top highlight instead of a drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Toasts and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers.

tokens.name: glow-brand
tokens.usage: Logo tile, focused primary surfaces.

tokens.name: glow-danger
tokens.usage: The incident banner and any card in CRITICAL state. Never on more than one block per screen besides that card.

tokens.name: glow-warning
tokens.usage: Degraded host tiles and bars over threshold.

tokens.name: glow-dot
tokens.usage: The LIVE dot. Swap the colour for danger dots in the event feed.
